result.summary: The page layout is largely coherent, but the favorite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' list are styled inconsistently, and a couple of minor visual inconsistencies exist in the card imagery/badges.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular background with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circular background with a white outlined heart. On the dark photo background the second button has poor contrast and looks broken or in a different state.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent button treatment (e.g., white/semi-opaque circle with a dark heart, or a consistent scrim) for all favorite toggles, reserving a visual change only for the actual 'favorited' state.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are inconsistent: the Green Bowl Poké image sits on a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark, vignetted photo backgrounds, making the row look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image backgrounds/overlays across carousel thumbnails so all cards share the same visual weight and badge legibility.

issues.description: The discount badge '−20%' and delivery badges are small green-on-white pills over imagery; the '€0 delivery' green text on white may fall below comfortable contrast at this size, and heart buttons have no visible text label.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge text weight/size or darken the green, and add accessible labels (e.g., 'Add to favorites') to icon-only buttons.
